title: Stanford Energy Seminar | The Renewables Reckoning: Bankruptcies, Buyouts, and America's Energy Supply
description: More than 100 renewable energy companies have filed for bankruptcy over the past 18 months, even as solar accounted for roughly 80% of new U.S. electricity generation last year. Nick Franchot of GoodFinch will explain what is driving the wave of distress and GoodFinch's strategy of acquiring assets out of bankruptcy.

description: How the world's largest logistics real estate company is driving clean energy procurement, on-site solar, and energy efficiency across its global portfolio.
